model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if BTC-USD on Coinbase trades at or above $150,000 at any point before January 1, 2027, 00:00 UTC (i.e., a confirmed trade price of ≥ $150,000 is recorded on the BTC-USD pair prior to that time).
- "No": Wins if BTC-USD on Coinbase does not reach $150,000 at any point before January 1, 2027, 00:00 UTC.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $150,000" means any single executed trade price (not a bid or ask quote) at or above $150,000.00 USD on the BTC-USD pair, as observable in trade history data.
